headerDisplay: Exposes each Bambu Lab printer's print status as a HomeKit Occupancy Sensor (occupied while actively printing) for use in automations.

ipAddress.title: IP Address
ipAddress.description: Must be static or DHCP-reserved - the plugin connects directly to this address.

serialNumber.title: Serial Number
serialNumber.description: Settings > General on the printer, or the Bambu Handy app device info.

lanAccessCode.title: LAN Access Code
lanAccessCode.description: Settings (cog icon) > General on the printer's touchscreen, shown in green.

rejectUnauthorized.title: Verify TLS Certificate
rejectUnauthorized.description: Bambu printers use a self-signed certificate, so this should normally stay off.

refreshIntervalSeconds.title: Full State Refresh Interval (seconds)
refreshIntervalSeconds.description: Off by default (0). The printer already pushes updates continuously on its own, and a full refresh already happens on every (re)connect - this periodic version only guards against a message silently vanishing while the connection stays up, a rare edge case. Set a positive value only if you want that extra safety net back.

reconnectDelaySeconds.title: Reconnect Delay (seconds)
reconnectDelaySeconds.description: Base delay before the first retry - doubles with each consecutive failure (exponential backoff) up to reconnectMaxDelaySeconds, rather than retrying at a constant rate forever.

reconnectMaxDelaySeconds.title: Reconnect Max Delay (seconds)
reconnectMaxDelaySeconds.description: Ceiling for the exponential backoff above - retries won't wait longer than this even during an extended outage.

enableNetworkPresenceCheck.title: Ping-gate reconnects (off by default)
enableNetworkPresenceCheck.description: Pings the printer before attempting a real MQTT connection - skips the attempt entirely if it's not even reachable at the network layer. Falls back to reconnecting normally if the ping check itself doesn't work in your environment (some minimal Docker containers lack a working ping binary).

mqttReconnectAlertThreshold.title: Connection Lost Alert Threshold (attempts)
mqttReconnectAlertThreshold.description: Sends a "check the printer" push after this many consecutive failed reconnect attempts, then again every that-many attempts while it stays down. Set to 0 to disable.

useLiveActivity.title: Use a Live Activity instead of Started/Progress/Finished pushes
useLiveActivity.description: One persistent, updating Lock Screen tile instead of a burst of separate notifications. Requires at least one entry in liveActivityDevices below - this is a per-device Pingie feature, a different credential from the group ID/token used for regular pushes. Filament cost and Electricity cost notifications still send separately either way.

liveActivityDevices.title: Live Activity Devices

deviceId.title: Device ID
deviceId.description: From the Notify! app's Devices tab on that device, not the Group ID used elsewhere in this config.

liveActivityDevices.description: Add one row per device you want the Live Activity tile to appear on. Pingie's Live Activity API has no group concept - the plugin sends one separate update to each device listed here, so the tile can appear on multiple phones even though Pingie itself only supports addressing a single device per call.

liveActivityKeepForSeconds.title: Finished Tile Lingers For (seconds)
liveActivityKeepForSeconds.description: How long the completed tile stays visible before clearing. 0 clears immediately.

liveActivityUpdateIntervalPercent.title: Live Activity Update Interval (%)
liveActivityUpdateIntervalPercent.description: Decoupled from the push-notification interval below - Live Activity updates are lightweight, so there's no real reason to throttle it the same way. Default updates on every 1% for a smoothly progressing tile.

enableRequestTopicSniffing.title: Enable AMS ID sniffer (diagnostic, off by default)
enableRequestTopicSniffing.description: Subscribes to the /request topic to discover values like the AMS drying ams_id by watching Bambu Studio's own commands. Turn on temporarily while hunting for a value, then back off - keeps MQTT traffic minimal otherwise.

filamentRunoutErrorCodes.title: print_error codes treated as "filament run-out"
filamentRunoutErrorCodes.description: Pre-filled from a community code mapping covering the external-spool and each AMS-slot run-out variant. Add more if the Homebridge log shows an unmatched pause code on a real run-out.

pingieGroupId.title: Pingie Notify! Group ID
pingieGroupId.description: Starts with GRP. Leave both Pingie fields blank to disable notifications.

pingieIconUrl.title: Pingie Notification Icon URL (optional)
pingieIconUrl.description: Small circular sender icon shown next to the title.

pingieImageUrl.title: Pingie Notification Image URL (optional)
pingieImageUrl.description: Larger hero image shown when the notification is expanded. JPEG/PNG/GIF, under 10MB, must be HTTPS.

averagePrintWattage.title: Average Print Power Draw (W)
averagePrintWattage.description: Used only for cost estimates. Leave blank to get duration-only notifications.

electricityRatePencePerKwh.title: Electricity Rate (pence/kWh)
electricityRatePencePerKwh.description: Used only for cost estimates. Leave blank to get duration-only notifications.

progressNotificationIntervalPercent.title: Progress Notification Interval (%)
progressNotificationIntervalPercent.description: Sends a notification every N percent complete, with time remaining. Set to 0 to disable.

startNotificationDelaySeconds.title: Print Started Notification Delay (seconds)
startNotificationDelaySeconds.description: Delays the "Print started" push (not the HomeKit switch) so the time estimate has a chance to populate first.

filamentPrices.title: Filament Prices

material.title: Material
material.description: Must match the type string exactly as it appears in your sliced files (e.g. PLA, PETG, ABS, PLA-CF) - case-sensitive.

filamentPrices.description: Add one row per material. A material not listed here still shows its weight in notifications, just without a cost.

progressDisplayMode.title: Progress Display
progressDisplayMode.description: "fan" = Progress % slider only. "countdown" = Light Sensor showing MM.SS time remaining only. "both" = both accessories. Switching modes automatically removes the tile(s) no longer in use.

showTemperatureSensors.title: Show bed/nozzle/chamber temperature sensors
showTemperatureSensors.description: Off by default. Adds three Temperature Sensor accessories to Home app.

amsId.title: AMS 2 Pro Drying ID (experimental)
amsId.description: Required to enable AMS Auto-Dry - no default, no auto-detection. Doesn't follow simple 0-3 numbering; the one confirmed working example used 131. Leave blank to skip this feature entirely.

amsHumidityUnitIndex.title: AMS Humidity Unit Index
amsHumidityUnitIndex.description: Which AMS unit (array position, not amsId) to read humidity from. 0 = first/only unit.

amsDryStartThreshold.title: AMS Dry Start Threshold
amsDryStartThreshold.description: Scale not confirmed - check the Homebridge log after enabling for a hint about whether this is a real percentage or a coarse 1-5 index.

amsDryTargetTemp.title: AMS Dry Target Temp (°C)
amsDryTargetTemp.description: Clamped to a minimum of 45 - the reverse-engineered command reportedly no-ops below that.

amsDryDurationHours.title: AMS Dry Hardware Failsafe Duration (hours)
amsDryDurationHours.description: Hardware-level cutoff independent of this plugin's own stop command, in case that never arrives (e.g. connection drop).

includeCameraSnapshot.title: Include a live camera snapshot in notifications
includeCameraSnapshot.description: Pulls the snapshot from camera.ui's own API (not a direct connection to the printer), then uploads it to GitHub for Pingie to fetch. Adds a couple seconds of latency per notification.

cameraUiCameraName.title: camera.ui Camera Name
cameraUiCameraName.description: Must match the camera's exact name as registered inside camera.ui - not necessarily this printer's name here.

githubToken.title: GitHub Personal Access Token
githubToken.description: Fine-grained PAT scoped to only "Contents: read and write" on the repo below - not a broad classic token.

githubRepo.title: GitHub Repo
githubRepo.description: Just the repo name, not the full URL. Must be public so raw.githubusercontent.com URLs work without auth.

githubSnapshotPath.title: Snapshot File Path in Repo
githubSnapshotPath.description: This one file gets overwritten each time, rather than accumulating a new file per notification.

includePrintPreviewImage.title: Use the sliced file's rendered preview as the notification icon
includePrintPreviewImage.description: Extracts the slicer-rendered plate thumbnail from the sliced 3MF (same image the touchscreen shows) via FTP - not the camera. Preferred over the camera snapshot if both are enabled. Not usable with Live Activities (SF Symbol icon only, no custom image support). Uses the same GitHub fields above.

githubPreviewImagePath.title: Preview Image File Path in Repo
githubPreviewImagePath.description: Separate file from the camera snapshot path above, so the two features don't overwrite each other if both are ever enabled.
